meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
700 रुपये के अंदर **acne-prone skin** ke liye sabse practical choice usually **2% Salicylic Acid serum** hota hai, especially agar **active pimples, blackheads, open pores, aur oily skin** hai.[4][6][7][9] Agar aapki skin **sensitive** hai ya pimples ke saath **redness/marks** bhi hain, to **azelaic acid** ya **niacinamide** better fit ho sakta hai.[1][11]

**Best picks under ₹700 (India):**

| Serum | Approx. price | Best for | Why choose it |
|---|---:|---|---|
| **Dot & Key Cica + 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** | ₹467–₹550 | Oily, acne-prone skin | Acne control ke liye strong budget option, oily/sensitive skin mention bhi milta hai.[7] |
| **Deconstruct Salicylic Acid Face Serum** | ₹599.25 | Acne, blackheads, open pores | Acne + pores ke liye simple, direct option.[9] |
| **The Derma Co 1% Salicylic Acid / acne-focused serum** | ₹526–₹650 range results me | Active acne | Budget me acne-targeting serum option.[1][2] |
| **The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1%** | ₹600 | Oil control, marks, mild acne | Acne-prone skin ke liye good if you want oil control + marks support.[2] |
| **Pilgrim 10% Niacinamide Face Serum** | ₹649 | Acne marks, blemishes, brightness | Marks aur oil control ke liye better than a pure acne treatment.[5] |
| **Derma Decode 10% Azelaic + 1% Kojic Acid** | ₹587 | Acne marks, redness, pigmentation | If active acne se zyada marks/redness issue hai.[1] |
| **Novology Acne Clearing Serum** | ₹646 | Acne treatment | Acne clearing category me listed under ₹700.[1] |

**Meri simple recommendation:**
- Agar aapko **fresh pimples/blackheads/oily skin** hai: **Dot & Key Cica + 2% Salicylic Acid** ya **Deconstruct Salicylic Acid Face Serum** lein.[7][9]
- Agar aapko **marks + mild acne + oil control** chahiye: **The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1%** ya **Pilgrim 10% Niacinamide**.[2][5]
- Agar skin **sensitive** hai aur pimples ke saath **dark marks** bhi hain: **Azelaic acid serum** better ho sakta hai.[1][11]

**Short answer:**  
Agar ek hi serum lena hai to **Dot & Key Cica + 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** ko first pick rakho, aur agar aapki skin sensitive ho to **Azelaic Acid serum** choose karo.[7][1]

Agar chaho, main aapke **skin type** ke hisaab se “best 3 exact serums” shortlist kar deta hoon—**oily / sensitive / dry-acne prone** me se jo aapki skin ho.
